Senior SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SQL Server DBA to manage and support enterprise database platforms across on\-premise and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). The role is primarily centered around Microsoft SQL Server, while also requiring strong hands\-on experience in PostgreSQL and exposure to modern cloud\-native database services.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should operate as a cross\-skilled senior DBA, capable of working across multiple database technologies, supporting both SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments in production, and contributing to cloud\-native database operations. The role demands strong ownership of critical systems, along with the ability to adapt to evolving database platforms across relational and non\-relational ecosystems.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. SQL Server Administration \& Production Operations
 



 2\. Multi\-Cloud \& Managed Database Operations
 



 3\. Cross\-Skilled Database Operations (SQL \+ PostgreSQL \+ Cloud DBs)
 



 4\. Database Migration \& Modernization Support
 



 5\. Production Support \& Reliability
 



  





  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



  




* 8–10\+ years of strong SQL Server DBA experience
* Min 6\+ years of hands\-on working experience with PostgreSQL
* Proven expertise in performance tuning, HA/DR, and production system management
* Min 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Azure SQL, AWS RDS, or other managed database platforms
* Exposure to MySQL / MariaDB and modern cloud\-native databases
* Strong troubleshooting, performance tuning, and scripting skills



  





 Automation \& DevOps Alignment
 



  





 • Support automation of database provisioning, monitoring, and maintenance tasks
 



 • Work with DevOps teams to integrate database operations within CI/CD pipelines
 



 • Use scripting (PowerShell, Python) for operational efficiency
 



 • Contribute to improving DBA processes through automation and standardization
 



 Professional Expectations
 



  





 • Strong ownership mindset for critical production systems
 



 • Ability to work across multiple database technologies and cloud environments
 



 • Effective collaboration with application, cloud, and DevOps teams
 



 • Team Player with a go getter mindset to contribute to project and practice initiatives
 



 • Clear communication during escalations, incidents, and production issues

description:
J
 **ob Description for the Oracle EBS DBA with OCI** 




**Oracle EBS Apps DBA with RAC and OCI** 




**Job Title:** 
 Oracle EBS Apps DBA
 



**Experience:** 
 6 to 10 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Remote
 



**About the Role** 




  





 The candidate will be responsible for managing the Oracle EBS application and database environments hosted on Oracle Exadata services within Oracle Cloud Services. The role requires strong technical expertise in EBS administration, database administration, RAC high availability, performance tuning, WebLogic Maintenance backup and recovery, cloud operations, and production support.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Oracle EBS Administration**
* Perform annual version upgrades from the existing 12\.2\.x release to the latest n\-1 supported version, as per business and Oracle support requirements.
* Perform application\-tier and database\-tier administration activities, including startup, shutdown, monitoring, troubleshooting, patching, cloning, and environment maintenance.
* Manage Oracle EBS services, including Concurrent Managers, Workflow Mailer, Forms, Reports, Apache/OHS, WebLogic Managed Servers, application listeners, and related application components.
* Perform ADOP online patching, application patching, technology stack patching, one\-off patch application, and post\-patch validation.
* Perform environment cloning activities, including production\-to\-test and test\-to\-development refreshes.
* Maintain EBS context files, AutoConfig, application file systems, dual file systems, and environment configurations.
* Troubleshoot login issues, concurrent program failures, workflow issues, forms issues, application performance issues, and application availability issues.
* Good at different patching techniques of adop, patch, and smart patch for various components for the EBS, WebLogic and Database.
* Apply required one\-off patches and coordinate with functional, technical, database, infrastructure, and Oracle Support teams to resolve production issues.
* Monitor and support production EBS environments configured with a shared application\-tier architecture, Parallel Concurrent Processing, internal nodes, and external\-facing nodes.



  





**Oracle Database and RAC Administration** 



* Manage Oracle databases supporting EBS environments.
* Administer Oracle RAC environments, including Grid Infrastructure, ASM, CRS, OCR, Voting Disk, SCAN Listener, VIP, database listeners, and database services.
* Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, patching, upgrade support, capacity management, and performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot RAC node failures, cluster service issues, ASM disk group issues, listener issues, interconnect problems, and database availability incidents.
* Manage tablespaces, datafiles, indexes, archive logs, FRA, undo, temporary tablespaces, and overall database growth.
* Use AWR, ADDM, ASH, SQL Trace, TKPROF, execution plans, SQL tuning methods, and performance diagnostic tools to identify and resolve database performance issues.
* Monitor production database instances 24x7 and ensure high availability with a target uptime of 99% or higher.
* Support high\-availability and disaster recovery requirements using Oracle RAC, RMAN, Data Guard, backup validation, restore testing, and operational monitoring.
* Coordinate with application, infrastructure, storage, network, and Oracle Support teams to resolve production issues and maintain service stability.



  





**OCI Administration** 



* Manage Oracle EBS application and database workloads hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Work with OCI services, including Compute, Block Volume, Object Storage, File Storage, VCN, Subnets, Security Lists, Network Security Groups, Load Balancer, IAM, Backup, and Monitoring.
* Support OCI resource provisioning, storage expansion, backup configuration, snapshots, compute scaling, and continuous environment monitoring.
* Manage and support Oracle Exadata services on OCI, including database availability, performance, storage, backup, patching coordination, and operational monitoring.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, security, cloud operations, and Oracle Support teams to troubleshoot issues and ensure stable service operations.
* Monitor OCI\-hosted EBS and database environments to ensure availability, performance, security, and compliance with operational requirements.



  





**Backup, Recovery and DR** 



* Configure, monitor, and maintain RMAN backup jobs for Oracle databases.
* Perform database restore, recovery, backup validation, and recovery testing as part of the quarterly disaster recovery drill.
* Support Oracle Data Guard configuration, monitoring, switchover, failover, and troubleshooting activities.
* Monitor standby database synchronization, redo apply status, archive log gaps, replication lag, and overall disaster recovery readiness.
* Ensure backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures are documented, tested, and aligned with the agreed Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective.
* Participate in quarterly DR drills to validate database recovery procedures, application availability, failover readiness, and compliance with agreed RTO and RPO targets.
* Identify gaps in backup, recovery, Data Guard synchronization, and DR readiness, and coordinate corrective actions to meet business continuity requirements.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong experience in Oracle EBS Apps DBA administration.
* Hands\-on experience in Oracle EBS R12\.2 architecture and support.
* Strong knowledge of ADOP, Autoconfigure, FNDCPASS, WebLogic, OHS, Concurrent Manager, Workflow Mailer, Forms, and Reports.
* Strong Oracle Database administration experience.
* Hands\-on experience in Oracle RAC, ASM, Grid Infrastructure, CRS, SCAN, VIP, and listeners.
* Experience in RMAN backup and recovery.
* Experience in Oracle Data Guard administration.
* Good understanding of OCI Compute, Storage, Network, IAM, Backup, and Monitoring.
* Good knowledge of Linux administration and shell scripting.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Oracle certifications will be an added advantage, preferably in one or more of the following areas:

 **Maersk** 
 , we are a global leader in integrated logistics, pioneering the industry for over a century. Our commitment to innovation and transformation continuously redefines the boundaries of what’s possible—setting new benchmarks for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

**Join us** 
 as we leverage cutting\-edge technologies and create global opportunities. Let’s sail together towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Master Data Management (MDM) Analyst to join our team. MDM Analyst will be responsible for managing, analyzing, and maintaining high\-quality master data within our systems. This role will involve collaborating with various stakeholders to ensure the accuracy and consistency of master data, supporting data quality initiatives, and adhering to data governance policies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Validate, and update master data requests, ensuring adherence to data quality rules and country\-specific exceptions.
* Conduct periodic quality checks on master data to maintain accuracy and consistency.
* Update vendor, material and customer master data in alignment with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and data guidelines.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve duplicate records within the master data system.
* Collaborate with Data Steward and Governance teams to support data quality initiatives and clean\-up activities.
* Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for master data processes.
* Participate in discussions with Business Partners and Stakeholders, addressing ad\-hoc requirements with urgency and professionalism.
* Utilize SQL queries to extract and analyze data for quality checks and reporting purposes.
* Create and maintain Power BI dashboards to monitor and report on data quality.
* Support audit requirements and ensure compliance with master data guidelines.
* Continuously improve data management processes by identifying areas for enhancement.


**Requirements:**
* Proven experience in Master Data Management (MDM) or a related field.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
* Strong communication skills for effective stakeholder interaction.
* Attention to detail with a proactive approach to resolving data issues.

title: Tech S And T - Manager Resilience DB - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**
 At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.
   

  

 As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact \- on your career, your community, and the world around you.
   

  

**Data Architect – Data Intelligence**
 We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to join our Data Intelligence team. This role will work in close partnership with cross functional teams to design, optimize, and govern the enterprise data ecosystem. The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in SAP and Microsoft data technologies, designing sustainable data architecture in data platforms while also supporting robust integration, scalability, and alignment with enterprise business strategies.
   

  

 The Data Architect will play a key role in shaping our enterprise\-wide data strategy, ensuring data assets are well\-structured, secure, and accessible to support analytics, reporting, and innovation across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and maintain data models, data flows, and integration architectures that align with enterprise strategy and enable interoperability across systems.
* Establish and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets.
* Provide data architectural leadership in designing ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into technical solutions that align with the overall enterprise data strategy and architecture.
* Parter with platform and engineering teams to ensure data platforms support data ingestion, ETL processes, advanced analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Stay current on emerging Microsoft, SAP, and cloud\-native data technologies and assess their potential application within the organization.
* Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of data management and integration technologies, with a focus on Microsoft Azure data services, SQL Server, Power BI, and SAP HANA/SAP BW.
* Supports the designs and implementation of the ETL process from various sources into the organization’s data systems.
* Define and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets and platforms to ensure consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
* Translates high\-level business requirements into data models and appropriate metadata, test data, and data quality standards


**Qualifications**

 **Senior Operations Support Engineer (Integration Platform)** 
 who will be responsible for operational management, support, monitoring, deployment, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration platforms. Ensures reliable and secure operation of more than 2,000 integrations and 1,200 supplier connections while providing operational support, onboarding, and incident management.

* Manage application, supplier, developer, and user onboarding, including access control, security permissions, and compliance alignment.

* Coordinate and drive platform deployments, environment migrations, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity activities.

* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, and operational automation.
